On January 29, 2026, the Turkish Football Federation issued a fine of 802,500 lira (approximately $18,500) to Amed S.F.K. and suspended its president, Nahit Eren, for "making ideological propaganda" after the club uploaded a video of a woman having her hair braided, which was linked to protests by Kurds against the 2026 northeastern Syria offensive.

FINAL: 802,500 lira fine

hits.text: 29 January – The Turkish Football Federation issues a fine of 802,500 lira ($18,500) on Diyarbakır-based club Amed S.F.K. and suspends its president, Nahit Eren, on charges of "making ideological propaganda" after the club uploads a video of a woman having her hair braided amid similar acts by Kurds in protests against the 2026 northeastern Syria offensive.
13 January – Ayfer Elmastaşoğlu, 81, footballer and football manager.
11 June–19 July – Turkey participates at the 2026 FIFA World Cup
20 May: 2026 UEFA Europa League final in Istanbul, Turkey
29 June – Arda Küçükyetim, 20, convicted attempted murderer (2024 Eskişehir stabbing).
